title: Derive artifact integrity metadata
description: Describe generated artifacts using their actual bytes and the retained identity/hash representations. This behavior produces factual metadata and trusted-chain inputs; it does not fabricate verification observations or grant trust to an arbitrary supplied archive.
inputs: Actual candidate artifacts and inventory, source/generator identity, requested release and target.
Selected metadata and integrity representation, official acquisition identity, and actual available validation observations.
outputs: Artifact metadata with source, version/target, filename, size, hashes, counts, roots, and attributable validation state.
Candidate metadata/index integrity relationships or explicit unsupported/inconsistent representation findings.
behavior: Derive artifact and tree identities from actual candidate bytes using the specified normalization, membership, ordering, and counting rules.
Keep current v2 generation and retained historical v1 verification semantics distinct; reject unknown algorithms.
Associate exact metadata bytes with their consuming release index and CLI package inputs without self-referential digests.
Keep generated expectations distinct from performed checks and preserve the actual observed validation basis.

failure_behavior.condition: Actual bytes, inventory, version, or declared target disagree with the metadata basis.
failure_behavior.outcome: Report the mismatch and withhold a coherent trusted-candidate descriptor.

failure_behavior.condition: A selected algorithm or representation is unknown.
failure_behavior.outcome: Reject the unsupported value before dependent consistency checks.

failure_behavior.condition: Required artifact content or observed result is unavailable.
failure_behavior.outcome: Expose the incomplete fact or unperformed check rather than inventing identity or validation success.
